notes: THE SEARCHES OF A FOLDER RUN AT ONCE. Measured on a real run: 53 seconds a folder, of which the picture judge was 7 and the downloads 5 - the rest was the searches, one after another, each with a pause. Now every search of a page sweep - both queries, both libraries, Pixabay's categories - runs at the same time and the answers are read in the old order, so the pool is the same pool sooner; the pause after each search is gone (the libraries' own published rates - Pexels 200 an hour, Pixabay 100 a minute - are kept by a pacer). Every folder line of the clips log says where its seconds went: (15 s: search 4, judge 7, download 4). THE TILE READS THE MADE THING ALONE: the first run on the armed tiles refused half its clips by words a quarter of a frame guesses wrong - a stream, a pine forest, a beach under a crab, 'possibly a garden'; a tile now refuses only by a made, captive or person thing it plainly shows - a fence, a wire, a tourist, a car, a tank, the zoo's furniture - never by a landform, a plant or a guess. The Setup screen and the install wizard carry a Get-a-free-key link for Pexels and Pixabay. An episode's state file is written by one writer at a time. Since 1.3.72: the page watches itself, the registry is renamed into place with a short wait, one press makes one episode.
